description: This Java class 'ConnectionPropertiesImpl' implements the 'ConnectionProperties' interface and encapsulates serial connection parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, and timeouts. It provides getters for these properties, a constructor to initialize them, and a toString method for representations.

classes.name: ConnectionPropertiesImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ConnectionProperties interface encapsulating serial connection settings.

methods.name: getDataBits
methods.description: Returns the number of data bits.

methods.name: getStopBits
methods.description: Returns the number of stop bits.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of connection properties.
